reason: A compatibility bridge that imports Claude Code marketplace plugins, skills, commands, and agents into DeepSeek Harness as callable dsh skills.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 市场中的插件、技能、命令和代理导入 DeepSeek Harness，并注册为可调用的 dsh 技能。
summaries.en: Imports Claude Code marketplace plugins, skills, commands, and agents into DeepSeek Harness as callable dsh skills.

capabilities: Scans project .claude directories and installed plugin metadata
Registers Claude Code skills, commands, and agents as dsh skills
Adds marketplaces and installs plugins from local paths, Git repositories, URLs, npm packages, or archives
Copies installed plugin contents into a local cache
Does not execute plugin hooks in the documented version
